svg.aria-label: Atelier: a creative studio that runs with zero API keys - every provider call passes the same three gates: the model registry (who may run), the budget gate (what it may cost), and the review trigger (what may be referenced) · sky = user surface · emerald = persistence · amber = provider boundary · rose = enforcement. Animated flows: colored dashes move along request paths; node borders breathe.
